steps.name: Fanatical Mafioso
steps.text: Is everybody here?

steps.name: Excited Mafioso
steps.text: Look behind you. The whole street belongs to us... an awe-inspiring pack of wolves.

steps.name: Fanatical Mafioso
steps.text: Good. No one should miss the Carnevale.

steps.name: Fanatical Mafioso
steps.text: The weapons?

steps.name: Excited Mafioso
steps.text: The secret weapon caches have been opened by the Don's orders. Guns, bombs, staves, crossbows... everything is fair game.

steps.name: Fanatical Mafioso
steps.text: Good! But remember the most important thing—keep your mask on.

steps.name: Fanatical Mafioso
steps.text: Nobody cares who's behind the mask, which famiglia they're from. Nothing you do will be punished.

steps.name: Fanatical Mafioso
steps.text: Carnevale—Siracusa's greatest festival!

steps.name: Fanatical Mafioso
steps.text: Cut down our foes! All the famiglie that oppose us will be swept aside! Nothing shall stand in our way in Siracusa!

steps.name: Excited Mafioso
steps.text: What about the officials of the city hall? They're even worse than the other famiglie, those slugs that keep babbling about their lofty ideals.

steps.name: Fanatical Mafioso
steps.text: The courthouse is right there behind us. They can sit and watch in that proud white tower of theirs... or get a crossbow bolt in their throat if they don't behave.

steps.name: Excited Mafioso
steps.text: I like the sound of that!

steps.name: Fanatical Mafioso
steps.text: Do you smell it in the wind? It's the smell of blood, just waiting for a chance to spill...

steps.name: Fanatical Mafioso
steps.text: Tonight, there is no Grey Hall, there are no laws, no rules, no order. Tomorrow, there will be a new order in Siracusa, starting with this new city—
Alright, I think the speech has gone on for long enough.
I'm—er... Noemi! Trainee officer at the Nuova Volsinii Police Department!

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Look around you! There is nowhere to run!

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: According to the New Urban Management Act, even members of the Dodici Famiglie must undergo a background check and standard registration prior to entering Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Your previous acts of violence are on record, and the violence that you are planning will not go unpunished. Illegal ownership and usage of weapons is a serious crime!

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Where do you think you are? Here, er, *ahem*...

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Nuova Volsinii has no place for famiglie!

steps.name: Off Screen
steps.text: Cut!

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: I thought I had it all memorized. I don't know why...

steps.name: Director
steps.text: There are only a few days until the Carnevale, Noemi. We need to finish this soon.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Sorry, I didn't think that my first task as a trainee would be shooting a movie...

steps.name: Director
steps.text: Are you nervous because of the camera, or because the scene in front of you looks real?

steps.name: Director
steps.text: If it's the former—look at these blokes here. I'm nervous that they'll let slip the names of their favorite pizzerias while trying to say their lines.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: I worked at my papa's pizzeria before I started police school...

steps.name: Director
steps.text: Anyway, you look good on screen and have a decent memory. You're the best one for the job.

steps.name: Director
steps.text: If it's the latter—you're a graduate of Siracusa's first police academy. You're gonna have to stare into the eyes of the wise guys at some point. It's your job.

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: B-Both, I guess...

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: I promised Papa that I'd finish my training and become a cop. I'll get my job done, whatever it is!

steps.name: Noemi
steps.text: Please let me have another go!

steps.name: Director
steps.text: Alright, Venezians, here we go for another take.

steps.name: Mafiosi Extras
steps.text: *Moan*—

steps.name: Director
steps.text: 3, 2, 1, action!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: ...What do you think?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What answer would you like to hear?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Maybe the actors playing the mafiosi should act more intimidating? Show just how far Nuova Volsinii has come?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Or maybe you don't like how Venezia Trucking is involved in the filming? But at least they have not attempted to challenge Nuova Volsinii's New Urban Management Act.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: They're just providing 'employees' as extras. They didn't even ask for ad space in the promotional video...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You know I'm not doing this because I like it.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I don't know, you look pretty happy in the limelight.

steps.name: Director
steps.text: Signore! It's almost time to shoot your speech!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Be right there!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I-I'll make sure they know I'm just the Acting Mayor...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Not for long, though.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: A grand festival, formal inauguration as mayor, a promotional video, your face in every corner of the city, so that no one would miss it...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We've talked about this, Lavinia.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We've done a lot in this new city. We've founded a new city hall, enacted the New Urban Management Act, and put into place policies that exclude the mafioso order...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But we have yet to face the big questions head-on—from Signora Sicilia, and the other famiglie that have designs on the new city.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Is there a better time than now?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Here, at the one-year anniversary of Nuova Volsinii, we have invited all citizens, even friends from abroad, to come to Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We have revived the word Carnevale, which has not been used in the last half-century, and given it new meaning, in order to demonstrate...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: This country can and will change the old things that bind it, and it starts with this city.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But how will painting a target on your back contribute to all that you've said?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We need a banner...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: And the famiglie of Siracusa are waiting for a target that they can attack and harm.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Just because the famiglie have kept a low profile doesn't mean they've given up on controlling this city. They have their eyes on you.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: ...I'm not afraid of them.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I won't let them have their way, not again...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I know how you feel, Leon, but what we need right now is not a reckless declaration of war.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You need to protect yourself. I don't want to see you...

steps.name: Director
steps.text: Signore! Are you ready?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: C-Coming!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The trucks will have to be returned to the union as soon as the shooting is done. They're needed for the festival preparations.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I know, half a day is as much as the union can give us. Don't worry, it's all been arranged.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I need to go. A lot to do at the courts.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Is there trouble?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Nothing major. Some issues with a few companies' registrations.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Their nose for loopholes in the law would put my law school classmates to shame.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: About dinner—

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: There's leftover pasta in the fridge. Help yourself.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: No... what I mean is...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I promised to join Demetri for dinner tonight... I can't avoid him forever.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Take care of yourself, Leon.

steps.name: Director
steps.text: Keep an eye on the camera's indicator light, Signore. We can begin when you're ready.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Good evening, citizens.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It is my honor to speak to you today as a citizen of Nuova Volsinii.

a.text: Welcome to a new era for Siracusa.

steps.name: Apprentice Tailor
steps.text: H-Here!

steps.name: Apprentice Tailor
steps.text: I had to walk five blocks and stand in a queue to buy this salami. And this wine is the best from Nonno's collection... he's not in any shape to drink anymore.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Good, little tailor, you're a good kid.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: There's so little to do at night in Nuova Volsinii. In the old days, on a night like this... hehe.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: (Cocky whistling)

steps.name: Apprentice Tailor
steps.text: (Awkward whistling)

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Eh, cut it out, Luchino! It's so damn dumb.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: I warned you last time when you tried to show off the jargon you learned from movies—

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Imitating a mafioso doesn't make you one. Besides... just get real, and stick to tailoring.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: ...Yes sir.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: Alright, you got your wine and salami. I got to go.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Going already? Thought you'd be pestering us for stories about the famiglia again.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: Nonno found out that I was hanging out with you. He doesn't want—

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Ha! And you want to be somebody?
What are you doing outside, Luchino?
The cops are stepping up their patrols ahead of the Carnevale. Don't let them catch you roaming on the streets.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: ...Nonno's calling.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: That old man—

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Everybody respected us and feared us back in the day. Now we're letting an old tailor like Umberto walk all over us.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Sure, follow the rules of wherever you end up, but the rule of Nuova Volsinii is to throw all the old rules out.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Even big famiglie with a seat in the Grey Hall, like the Saluzzo, have to keep their tail firmly between their legs here... how times have changed.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: 'Saluzzo'...

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: Er, I'm going in.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: N-Nonno.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: ...The suit's already packed. You remember where to deliver it to, right?

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: Come back right away if the customer doesn't have any requests after trying it on.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: I know this is a special client, and I know you've always wanted to meet the 'real VIPs'.

steps.name: Umberto
steps.text: *Cough*—

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: I know, I know, you've said it many times.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: I'll get your medicine on the way and come back as soon as I've made the delivery. Don't worry, just get some rest.

a.text: Slowly, but surely. We can all see it.
We are taking back what should have been ours all along. Our lives, our courage.
The burden of history weighs heavy. Sometimes, we find our feet mired in the past.
But we will keep walking. We will never stop.

steps.name: Anxious Truck Driver
steps.text: I came here first! You're cutting the line!

steps.name: Famiglia Company Employee
steps.text: Which company do you represent, sir?

steps.name: Anxious Truck Driver
steps.text: I... I'm with the Truckers' Union. I have important documents that I need Judge Lavinia to take care of today. I have an appointment with her!

steps.name: Famiglia Company Employee
steps.text: How important? Will it bring hundreds of millions of florins in investments to Nuova Volsinii?

steps.name: Anxious Truck Driver
steps.text: Well, no...

steps.name: Famiglia Company Employee
steps.text: Then it's nothing particularly urgent.

steps.name: Famiglia Company Employee
steps.text: I suggest that you remain patient while important business is being discussed behind those doors, involving numbers that you cannot even fathom.

steps.name: Famiglia Company Employee
steps.text: That's the biggest contribution you can make to the city.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: I must remind you, Judge Lavinia, that the law is founded upon the principle of fairness, and no one should receive special treatment.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: It is difficult not to suspect that you frequently target companies under the Saluzzo banner out of your own prejudice against us.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Did you say prejudice?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: It is past nine in the evening, signore. Did you think I volunteered to do overtime, unpaid, and go through the ordeal of sitting in a room with you, just so I could satisfy my 'prejudice'?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Here is Saluzzo Vino's previous submission for their new winery, which lists one hundred and thirty security personnel.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Here is the revised submission, which instead lists thirty logistics personnel, fifty winemakers, and fifty technical personnel.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You don't have to respect me, signore, but the least you could do is respect the New Urban Management Act, and have a modicum of common sense.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: ...What will it take for you to stop breathing down our necks?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Easy. Nuova Volsinii welcomes any honest business with open arms, but there is no place here for any dishonest famiglia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Saluzzo can sell his wine to Leithanien, Columbia, even Ursus for all I care...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But not a single shelf in Nuova Volsinii will carry wine bearing the label of Saluzzo's new winery until it passes the qualification audit.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: I'll give it to you, Judge Lavinia. Not one government or court employee has dared talk to us like this in the entire history of Siracusa.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: The law of Nuova Volsinii bends for no one.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Get used to it, or things are only going to get harder for you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I've already wasted too much time with Saluzzo wines today, signore. Kindly remove yourself from my office, and remove your men from the door, because they're in the way of that lady outside.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I heard the impertinence that you showed towards her. She deserves an apology.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Anxious Truck Driver
steps.text: Good evening, Judge Lavinia! Sorry to take up your time, but please, take a look at this!

steps.name: Anxious Truck Driver
steps.text: It's the dispatch record of the Truckers' Union in recent days, recording the driver, cargo, route, and time of every dispatch.

steps.name: Anxious Truck Driver
steps.text: There's so much that it took quite a while to put together... I would like you to review it.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Thanks. It's very detailed... but why are you asking me to review it?

steps.name: Anxious Truck Driver
steps.text: You said logistics around the Carnevale is really important, and to be on guard of smugglers...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Yes, but it was just a reminder... besides, you're the president of the Truckers' Union, Eirene. You can make your own judgment.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Oh... you recognize me?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: It's not like we haven't met before... the most diligent driver in Nuova Volsinii, and the most trusted leader of the Nuova Volsinii Freight Workers and Truck Drivers Mutual Aid Association.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: It's always going to be just 'Truckers' Union' to us...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Without workers and drivers like you, there would be no Nuova Volsinii. You should all be proud of yourselves.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: T-Thank you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'll take the report. Thank you for your vigilance; I trust your judgment... is there anything else?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Well... the list of new truck drivers that we submitted last week hasn't been approved yet.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I would like to provide my assurance for one of the names on the list...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You understand, Eirene, why we're very thorough about background checks for truck drivers...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Of course! I know... logistics is very important to Nuova Volsinii. We can't give the famiglie a chance to get their foot in!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: A Reproba from Ursus with almost no social relations and whose past is virtually unknown... You do see my concern, right?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I-I promise, she has nothing to do with the mafia. And she's a great driver!

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Her resume is like this because she's had some hard luck... she really, really needs a job right now!

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I'm thinking, Judge Lavinia... the laws of Nuova Volsinii protect us from the mafia. When our citizens need help, perhaps...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Oh, I don't mean to pressure you! You should deal with it whatever way you see fit—

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You're too wound up, Eirene.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I can see that you're trying to keep your distance from me.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I, I really like you and Signor Bellone, Judge Lavinia, I really do!

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Hehe, thanks.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Same for Sommer.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Sommer? The driver who came with you to Nuova Volsinii? The one always with a lighter in his hand...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: You remember! He's my best friend.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: We came to Nuova Volsinii a year ago. Back then, City Hall's notice about the Truckers' Union had been up for half a month, but no one dared to apply, fearing mafia reprisals.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Sommer and I read it a few times and were about to leave when you and Signor Bellone stopped us.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You stood before the notice longer than anyone else.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: ...We came because we couldn't stay in Sicilia.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I remember what you said to me... I, I don't mean to make this awkward, but my life would be very different without you.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I know you don't want the famiglie—I mean, 'companies' to interfere in Nuova Volsinii's logistics, and I know they haven't given up on it.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: The result, however, is that the Truckers' Union has become the only legal transportation organization, and it is growing by the day...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: All our drivers have something in their past that they're not proud of, before they came to Nuova Volsinii...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Anyway, we're all looking for a fresh start, a second chance.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That's why you don't want to be seen to be too close to City Hall or the courts.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I know, there are many things that will take time to get there.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: But I promise you that the mafia will never get a foothold in the Truckers' Union.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: And I voted for Signor Bellone when he ran for mayor! Everyone can see how well he’s done as Acting Mayor for the past year. I'm sure—*grumble*.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Haven't had dinner yet?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I-I'm fine! I'm not hungry yet...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I still have some pizza here, if you don't mind that it's gotten a little cold.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I-I can't possibly...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Think of it as helping me out. It's too much for me to finish on my own, and we can't very well talk about work on an empty stomach, can we?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Besides, there is no greater crime in Siracusa than letting good, authentic pizza go to waste.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: If you put it that way... I guess it would be rude to refuse.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Tell me more about the present state of the Truckers' Union, Eirene.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Oh, uh... okay!

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Average pizza sauce last month is up five times from the previous months...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Oh, I mean, dispatches...

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: And this pizza sauce is really good.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Maybe we should finish our dinner first.

a.text: A friend once said something that really left an impression on me—
'Our power comes from the very lives we have created.'
Our power will protect all that we have built.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: That's the fifth slice of pizza and third glass of juice that you just eliminated. Are you that hungry?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Shut up and drink this espresso.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It's so damn sour!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If we screw up this mission because this swill makes me throw up, whose head am I gonna give the boss, yours?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Live with it. I just picked it up off the shelf.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Nobody uses this frontage road anyway. Besides, it's just transporting a bunch of 'tires', what could go wrong?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: No need to get all worked up about an unimportant job like this.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I'm tired of listening to your complaints for the past two months, Gambino.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Haven't you figured out our new boss yet? Trying too hard to show off in front of him will only have the opposite effect.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Fresh meat like us, we gotta be patient and wait for our chance.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Well, ain't you the model employee, Capone.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I thought you would at least show a little bit of, I don't know, shame? There's hardly any place for a Sicilian in Siracusa these days.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I'm not Sicilian anymore. It's your shame, not mine.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I just want to get my Nuova Volsinii citizenship sooner rather than later. All the work I put in over the past six months, all the guarantee money I paid, and I'm only halfway to the required points—

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Halfway?! You've got fifty more points than I do? Have you been doing—*gasp*—community service while I wasn't looking?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Shut your crap, Gambino. We're on our last chance and you know it.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Keep your eyes sharp on the street. It should be coming any time now—

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You got any pizza left? Give me one.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Cazzo, it's cold, how do you even manage to eat this...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Ach... I'm late.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: You're late, Leon.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm sorry, it's been a really busy day.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Still working on your inaugural speech?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Well, that too... We're planning a birthday party for an entire city. It's not quite the same as planning a party at home, is it?

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: I'm surprised... you still remember.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Of course I do. Did you think I was going to forget how you bought ginger ale instead of beer for the banquet, and pocketed the difference to buy a car?

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Well, I guess that DID happen.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You sound... distracted, Demetri.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Do I? It's nothing. I guess it's been too long since we last saw each other.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Take care on your way, Leon.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Might have taken that as a threat, if we weren't in Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Enough joking and hurry up. I'm waiting at the seat by the window.
Leontuzzo hangs up.
He has not seen the man on the other end of the phone for a year now. He knows what he wants and how to decline his offer.
Leontuzzo shakes his head at the thought of the reunion, which promises to be a less-than-pleasant one.
A beam of light shines on his face.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: What the—who drives like that?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Wait, that vehicle—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Hey, what's going on with my steering wheel—
Keep your distance! It's dangerous!
Out of the way! Make way for the stretcher!
Signore! Can you hear me?
Hang in there! The ambulance is almost here!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Where... am... I...
Stay still, signore! You've lost a lot of blood—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Who is... that...?
The last thing Leontuzzo remembers before he loses consciousness is a blurry yellow silhouette—
A taxi.
The Carnevale has brought countless visitors from Siracusa and beyond to Nuova Volsinii.
This taxi does not seem different from any other that carries visitors across the city.
Except for the great, strange shadow that it wears.
Not cast by the towering buildings, nor a trick of the neon lights. It is the shadow of a wolf.
The taxi slithers through the city like a ghost, carrying a wolf from the wilderness.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Slower, Lappland.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What? The ageless, deathless Signore dei Lupi, afraid of being thrown out of a car?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: It's your car I'm worried about. Keep driving it like this, and it'll fall apart.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: We managed to get it fixed when it was just a bunch of scrap metal lying out there in the wilderness. It's strong, trust it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Or do you not trust my driving skills? I don't fool around with my own life... except when necessary.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: You don't want the police to find you and throw you in jail, or the mafia to find you and throw you into a meat grinder, do you? At least, not yet.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: We're getting better at reading each other's minds, Zaaro.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: We still have a Carnevale to go to, after all.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: I thought you would scorn the Carnevale for lacking in revelry, seeing all the colorful lights and balloons that line the streets.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Carnevale had been a thing for centuries, dating back to when Siracusa was just a backwater province of Leithanien.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The Lupo of Siracusa found that they were still restless and uneasy, even after getting their own city, and the order of the famiglia.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And so, for a few days in a year, the famiglie run amok in the city, settling scores, fighting over territory, or simply engaging in wanton violence.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Assault, arson, robbery, murder—everything was fair game as long as you had your mask on.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The first thing Signora Sicilia did when she came to power was to abolish the festival, but Nuova Volsinii has persuaded her to permit its revival.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: They hope that reviving the festival without the brutality and cruelty would give this blank slate of a city new meaning, and a sense of belonging for the people who have come to seek out a new life.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Is that not Carnevale—a wonderful thing?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Have we gotten into poetry now? Your showmanship is beyond mortal help, Lappland.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Just excited about it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I promise that the reborn festival will be an unforgettable one for everyone—the Lupi included.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: I hope you remember our agreement. This round is coming to a close. Do not disappoint me, Lappland.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: As I said, our battle will continue for thousands upon thousands of years.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Well, strap in, and hang on—
